g.text: +5V raw (D105-D108), +20V (D109-D112) and +12V power (D113-D116) bridges are four STPS20M100S 100 V / 20 A D2PAK Schottky diodes each, cooled by the pours under their tabs. +50V (2 x 2200uF/100V, bleeder R259||R260) feeds the coils through F103/F104/F105 (J107-1 also feeds the 8-driver board).
